held_out_system.independence: Giannutri and these daily flower-visit networks were not used to build ABM v4, v5 or v6, the Ogasawara diagnosis, or the Menorca falsification. This is a new empirical system for a layer-specific v6 local-support/realization test.

selection_caveat: The published study and its source code were known before this freeze to analyze daily network structure and resource overlap under hive-open versus hive-closed conditions. Therefore system selection and the general relevance of network reorganization are not outcome-blind. Exact izu-core interaction-Shannon, Morisita-Horn plant-overlap, positive-pollinator-support fraction, and their v6 predictive positions have not been calculated or inspected before this freeze.

source_native_reconstruction.initial_daily_sampling_filter: Count unique transetto values by Date; dates with <=2 transects are removed unless explicitly restored by the source pooling rule.
source_native_reconstruction.source_pooling_rule: Pool Date 20240225 and 20240228; assign all pooled rows Date=20240225 and day=56; remove the original low-transect dates and then append the pooled rows.
source_native_reconstruction.minimum_observation_filter: For every candidate Date, aggregate total by species+plant. For Anthophora_dispar and Bombus_terrestris separately, exclude plant='volo' and sum total; remove the Date if either species has fewer than 10 observations.
source_native_reconstruction.daily_pair_weight: For each remaining Date, sum source column total over duplicate species x plant rows; set higher=species, lower=plant, freq=sum(total), remove plant='volo', and reconstruct the quantitative bipartite network. izu-core stores the equivalent matrix as plant rows x pollinator columns.
source_native_reconstruction.day_order: ascending numeric Date after all source-native pooling and filters
source_native_reconstruction.expected_final_count_rule: The exact reconstruction must yield 29 daily networks. If it does not, block before target calculation rather than changing filters or selecting a subset.
source_native_reconstruction.source_published_null_models: not used in the izu-core v6 validation

conditional_layer_test.reason: The published daily network is deliberately restricted to three focal bee species, so this test conditions on the empirically admitted three-bee pool rather than treating it as a whole-community realization of v4 island opportunity.
conditional_layer_test.empirical_feasible_baseline: Pool all 29 source-selected daily matrices after the exact source-native filters, summing pair weights over Date. Preserve the union of plant identities and exactly the three frozen pollinator identities. This pooled quantitative network is a conditioning baseline, not a fitted v6 parameter.
conditional_layer_test.hive_condition_role: Retained as source metadata only. Primary predictive adequacy treats the 29 days as unlabeled local contexts and may not select v6 settings by open/closed condition.

primary_support_estimand.name: three_pollinator_positive_support_fraction
primary_support_estimand.empirical_definition: Among the 29 source-selected daily networks, the fraction with positive total interaction weight for all three focal bee species. The source minimum-observation rule guarantees Anthophora_dispar and Bombus_terrestris meet the source threshold; Apis_mellifera may or may not have positive daily support.
primary_support_estimand.secondary_support_diagnostic: number of distinct positive focal-pollinator support sets observed across the 29 daily networks
primary_support_estimand.no_positive_weight_threshold_tuning: positive support means summed source total > 0 exactly; no abundance threshold is selected after inspection

empirical_statistics.interaction_shannon_relative_daily_range: (max daily interaction_shannon - min daily interaction_shannon) / pooled-29-day baseline interaction_shannon
empirical_statistics.plant_niche_overlap_relative_daily_range: (max daily mean_plant_niche_overlap_morisita_horn - min daily value) / pooled-29-day baseline mean_plant_niche_overlap_morisita_horn

weighted_architecture_estimands.comparability_rule: If any of the 29 admitted daily networks has no positive interactions or undefined plant niche overlap, block structural comparability; do not drop the day. If a pooled denominator is non-positive or undefined, block rather than renormalize.

v6_predictive_distribution.baseline: the checksum-locked pooled empirical three-bee quantitative network defined above
v6_predictive_distribution.source_ascertainment_conditioning: For each synthetic context, condition the generic v6 independent pollinator-support draw on Anthophora_dispar and Bombus_terrestris being active, matching the source rule that retains only days with >=10 observations for each of those two species. Apis_mellifera remains free to be active or inactive according to the frozen support strength. Conditioning is on source ascertainment only, not on any target metric.
v6_predictive_distribution.weight_realization: Apply the unchanged v5 positive affinity reweighting at the frozen weight strength after the conditional v6 support mask.
v6_predictive_distribution.row_budget_rule: Each positive pooled plant row must retain its exact pooled row total after support filtering and weight realization. If a permitted support mask removes every positive partner for any positive pooled plant row, that predictive replicate is a structural v6 failure and must not be skipped, repaired, or replaced by another mask.

decision_rule.structural_gate: No predictive replicate may violate the frozen v6 row-budget/admissibility rule. Any such violation is retained as v6 structural failure on the Giannutri conditioning baseline.
decision_rule.support_adequacy: The empirical three-pollinator-positive-support fraction must fall within the prespecified central 2.5-97.5% envelope of the equal-weight 29-context v6 predictive distribution.
decision_rule.shannon_adequacy: The empirical interaction-Shannon relative daily range must fall within the central 2.5-97.5% v6 envelope.
decision_rule.overlap_adequacy: The empirical plant-niche-overlap relative daily range must fall within the central 2.5-97.5% v6 envelope.
decision_rule.headline: v6 survives the Giannutri conditional local-support test only if the structural gate passes and all three frozen empirical estimands (support fraction, Shannon range, plant-overlap range) fall inside their frozen predictive envelopes. Failure of any component is retained; metrics are not averaged into a pass.

prohibited_after_target_calculation: change the source open/closed inclusion rule
change the three focal bee species
change the <10 observation rule for Anthophora_dispar or Bombus_terrestris
drop, merge, or reweight any of the final 29 daily networks
change pair weight away from sum(total) by species x plant x Date
choose support or weight strength using Giannutri fit
use hive condition to choose a preferred setting for the primary test
drop Apis-only plant rows to rescue support-mask admissibility
skip or redraw structurally invalid v6 contexts
change the three primary estimands or 2.5-97.5% envelopes after seeing Giannutri values
replace a failed izu-core result with the source paper's H2, weighted NODF, niche-overlap, or null-model result
claim_boundary: This is a conditional test of the v6 local partner-support plus within-support realization mechanism on a new island system. It conditions on the source-defined three-bee pooled network and therefore does not validate v4 whole-community island opportunity for Giannutri. Passing would support the local mechanism class under source ascertainment; failing would identify a remaining structural or amplitude mismatch without permitting Giannutri-specific retuning.
